notes: PARENTAGE DOCUMENTED: Haddonfield MM marriage record reads 'Albertson, John (s Josiah and Eleanor), and Ann Pine (d John) 11-20-1794' — son of Josiah Jr. and Eleanor Tomlinson, married ANN PINE on 20 Nov 1794 (the export's 13 Oct 1794 was the declaration of intentions; Craig's 'Ann Price' reading of it is a transcription error). Ann was daughter of John and Rachel (Burrough) Pine of Gloucester County; she died aged ~89 (tree: 2 Dec 1863).

Orphaned in infancy: father Josiah Jr. died winter 1782/3; guardianship files for the minor John at NJ Index of Wills, Gloucester Co. 1423H (B.26 p.47) and 1531H (B.28 p.124). Inherited the Otter Branch plantation under grandfather Josiah's 1783 will and KEPT IT — born in the 1743 brick house, and his youngest son Chalkley was born there in 1816 'on the paternal estate, where his ancestors had lived for more than a century' (Biographical Review, 1897).

TEN children (1897 Biographical Review; Chalkley explicitly 'the youngest-born of the family group of ten'): incl. Josiah (1795-1849, m. Abigail C. Hodson at Haddonfield MM 21 Mar 1822), Isaac Pine (1797), Rachel (m. Champion Atkinson 1827), Eleanor (m. Moses Rulon 1825), Ann, Mary, John Jr, Keturah, Chalkley (1816). Duplicate record I182197730733 carries nine of them.

Will: NJ Index of Wills, Gloucester Co. file 4876H — 'W. 1842. Inv. 1843.' (Camden Co. not created until 1844). After his death Chalkley bought out the co-heirs and the homestead descended in Chalkley's branch.

ISAAC J ALBERTSON (I182195862458, 1824-1896) IS NOT HIS SON — resolved 2026-07-03: Chalkley (b. 1816) was the youngest of the ten, and Ann Pine was ~49 in 1824. Isaac is almost certainly John's GRANDSON via Josiah (1795-1849) & Abigail Hodson; see Isaac's record. The export's John->Isaac link skips a generation.
DUPLICATE: also exists as I182197730733 (and Ann as I182197730682); this record is primary.

TENTH CHILD FOUND (research workflow, 2026-07-03): Find A Grave lists a 10th child, HANNAH, not previously tracked alongside the 9 already recorded here (Josiah, Isaac Pine, Rachel, Eleanor, Ann, Mary & John Jr as twins b. 27 Jul 1810, Keturah, Chalkley) — 5 sons/daughters total in twin pairs plus singles, per that source. Also independently re-raised the marriage-date question already settled elsewhere on this record: Find A Grave's biography gives 20 Nov 1794, matching the Haddonfield MM marriage-record date already established here (not the export's 13 Oct 1794, which is the earlier declaration-of-intentions date).
